service.description: One message from the person about an audit, optionally with a finding open. The router splits it into items; read questions are grounded and answered; cause and rule comments become one draft change (for a person to approve with apply#AuditChange) or a staff ticket. Keys, secrets, emails and phones are masked before anything is stored or sent. outcome: AGENT_OFF, AGENT_UNAVAILABLE, RATE_LIMITED, OVER_BUDGET, DECLINED, QUESTION, DONE, INCOMPLETE, TENANT_CHANGED or ERROR.

parameter.name: conversationId
parameter.description: Continue this conversation; empty starts one.

parameter.name: findingId
parameter.description: The finding the panel is open on.

parameter.name: proposals
parameter.description: {proposalId, kind, status, statusMessage, provenanceStatus, blockedIds, backtest}

parameter.name: question
parameter.description: {text, options, from} when the agent needs the person's answer.

parameter.name: masked
parameter.description: The kinds of secret or personal data masked in the text (never the values).
